DONNELLY (Tankards Garden, Newbridge) - 28th February 2014 (peacefully) at Naas Hospital. John (Sean); deeply regretted by his brother Brendan, sister Maura, sister-in-law Norah, nephews and nieces, grand-nephew, grand-nieces, relatives and friends. 

May he Rest in Peace.

 

Reposing at Anderson & Leahy's Funeral Home, Newbridge from 6pm on Monday evening with Rosary at 8pm. Removal on Tuesday evening at 6pm to arrive at the Dominican College Church at 6.30pm. Funeral after 12.15pm Mass on Wednesday to Barrettstown Cemetery.
